title: 交易业绩再破纪录：高预期下仍超预期，下半年能否延续
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: They beat expectations, generally, which is, and expectations were high coming into this quarter.
segments.zh: 总体来看，他们超出了预期，而本季度的预期本身就很高。

segments.en: What are they saying about the back half of the year? I guess that's probably the bigger issue.
segments.zh: 他们对下半年怎么看？这可能是更大的问题。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right. That's the chief question on the earnings cost today.
segments.zh: 没错，这是今天财报电话会议的核心问题。

segments.en: We had robust results, knocked it out of the park, particularly in equity trading.
segments.zh: 业绩强劲，尤其权益交易方面表现突出。

segments.en: Can the speech sustain at least from the JP Morgan earnings call earlier this morning?
segments.zh: 这种势头能否持续？今早摩根大通的财报电话会议给出了信号。

segments.en: And said that while it's hard to replicate the second quarter earnings results from equity trading in particular, there's still a constructive backdrop.
segments.zh: 他们表示，虽然第二季度权益交易业绩难以复制，但整体背景依然有利。

segments.en: Some of the activity in the second quarter was really driven by the trading activity from SpaceX and the like that, that may be a bit more idiosyncratic to the quarter,
segments.zh: 第二季度的部分交易活动由SpaceX等驱动，可能更具季度特殊性。

segments.en: but still really strong trading results expected for the back half of the year.
segments.zh: 但下半年交易业绩预期依然非常强劲。

segments.en: What are the, the backs of the big lending books like Walk Over You, like B.A.V.
segments.zh: 大型贷款机构如美国银行、花旗的贷款账目情况如何？

segments.en: like City, what is saying about the credit quality out there?
segments.zh: 它们对信贷质量有何看法？

segments.en: Yeah, credit quality has been really strong. You see that in Wells Fargo in particular there, net chargeoffs for the quarter of their loan losses were down about 10 basis points, and that was really led by much lower commercial
segments.zh: 信贷质量确实很强，特别是富国银行，季度净坏账率下降了约10个基点，主要得益于商业贷款损失大幅降低。

segments.en: loan losses in particular. So the commercial borrowers have been able to weather some of this economic insurgency and expectations for rates to be higher for longer.
segments.zh: 商业借款人能够承受当前经济压力以及利率长期高企的预期。

segments.en: So we're actually pretty sanguine about the credit quality for the group, at least in the near to intermediate term.
segments.zh: 因此，我们对近期至中期内的信贷质量持乐观态度。
